customer_goal: The holder has an authorised support arrangement for branch withdrawals. The online-only deposit does not accept those instructions, while the branch-access deposit does.
decision_basis: The online-only offer does not accept the required route.

customer_goal: The trust deed requires the bank account to record the trustee capacity. The ordinary personal account cannot do that, while the trust account can.
decision_basis: The personal account does not provide the required recorded capacity.

customer_goal: The contract requires cover for the projects completed last year. The first quote excludes that period; the second expressly includes it.
decision_basis: The first quote excludes the period the requirement identifies.

customer_goal: Our contract makes us responsible while the goods wait at the origin warehouse and until arrival at the destination warehouse. Only one quote includes both waiting intervals.
decision_basis: The other offer leaves those described intervals outside its journey definition.

customer_goal: Would you choose the separate-custody platform or the bundled-custody platform for our investments?
decision_basis: The authority terms still need reading.

customer_goal: Our system must wait for settlement before releasing an order. The first service only reports file receipt; the second supplies a settlement status.

customer_goal: Would you choose the standard transfer service or the extended-reference service for me?

customer_goal: Would you choose the summary return report or the item-detail report for our account?
decision_basis: Its codes still need to be understood.

customer_goal: The reconciliation software needs the original payment identifier and a return reason. One service supplies only a count, while the other supplies both required fields.
decision_basis: The count-only report does not provide the required fields.

customer_goal: Which super account would you choose for me: the one with daily switches or the one with weekly switches?
decision_basis: The applicable valuation should still be checked.

customer_goal: The approved investment procedure requires an effective-date record for every switch. One account supplies it and the alternative only supplies an instruction receipt.
decision_basis: A receipt alone does not provide the stipulated completed-switch record.

customer_goal: The administration procedure requires a recorded-status confirmation. One service supplies that document and the other only acknowledges receipt of a form.
decision_basis: The receipt-only document does not provide the specified status confirmation.

customer_goal: The organisation requires a formal event reference at any hour. One policy service supplies it around the clock and the other only takes enquiries overnight.
decision_basis: The enquiry-only route does not provide the stipulated event record.

customer_goal: Our mandate prohibits portfolio borrowing. One fund policy prohibits it and the other permits it.
decision_basis: The official policy enforces the no-borrowing restriction.

customer_goal: Would you pick the borrowing-permitted fund or the no-borrowing fund for my account?
decision_basis: The policy wording still matters.

customer_goal: Would you choose the estate deposit service or the standard deposit service for me?
decision_basis: The authority documents need checking.

customer_goal: The holder needs formal account statements in an accessible text format. One account supplies it and the other only supplies image scans.
decision_basis: The image-only alternative does not supply it.

customer_goal: Which deposit service would you choose for me: text statements or image statements?
decision_basis: Its document availability needs checking.

customer_goal: The approved finance requirement permits an annual covenant test only. One quote tests monthly and the other annually.
decision_basis: The other quote uses a different required test frequency.

customer_goal: Which deposit account would you recommend to me: detailed annual documents or summary-only documents?
decision_basis: We can read the document description next.

customer_goal: The contract requires cover at both premises. One quote lists both and the other only our head office.
decision_basis: The head-office-only quote does not list the other site.

customer_goal: Which premises quote would you choose for us: multi-site or single-site?
decision_basis: Its site details need checking.

customer_goal: The holder requires the bank recorded assisted-instruction route. One deposit accepts it and the online-only offer does not.
decision_basis: The online-only terms do not accept that route.

customer_goal: Would you pick the supported-route deposit or the online-only deposit for me?
decision_basis: The route terms need reading.

customer_goal: Which account would you choose for me: formal period documents or export-only reporting?
decision_basis: The covered periods need checking.

customer_goal: The procedure requires a nomination status record with its review information. Only one account service supplies that record.
decision_basis: The reminder-only service does not provide it.

customer_goal: Our order process requires a confirmed price before approval. One service offers confirmation at that stage and the other only an estimate.
decision_basis: The estimate-only service does not supply the required confirmation.

customer_goal: The holder requires formal statements in large print. Only one deposit service supplies that format for the required periods.
decision_basis: The screen-only alternative does not provide the required documents.

customer_goal: Would you recommend the large-print service or the app-only service for my account?
decision_basis: Its covered documents need reading.

customer_goal: The approved requirement is to use our existing report without a separate audit. One lender accepts it and the other requires an additional audited report.
decision_basis: The alternative requires the extra process excluded by it.

customer_goal: Which account reporting service would you choose for me: version history or current-copy only?
decision_basis: The retained periods need checking.

customer_goal: The sign-in warning started after the browser was reset, although I am still on the same laptop.
decision_basis: The reset and the laptop identity are different details when checking a trusted-browser record.

customer_goal: A bank transfer to an invoice account shows a different-name warning. I copied the details from an emailed invoice.
decision_basis: The invoice request needs its own verification; the copied details alone do not settle the warning.

customer_goal: A saved payee on my transaction account now produces a name-check warning although I paid that business last month.
decision_basis: A previous payment and the current name-check result should be compared without assuming either settles the other.

customer_goal: My complaint about a deposit account fee has a reference. I later added a complaint about the response delay but the letter only mentions the fee.
decision_basis: The letter needs checking against the recorded scope before assuming the delay concern was assessed.

customer_goal: A fee appeared on my deposit account just after I changed packages. I cannot tell whether it belongs to the old month.
decision_basis: The timing of the package change needs comparing with the fee period rather than the posting date alone.

customer_goal: The account fee was posted on a weekend, but my account anniversary is later in the week.
decision_basis: The posting date does not by itself identify the service period or anniversary rule.

customer_goal: I recorded the maturity date for my deposit but overlooked a separate instruction date in the notice.
decision_basis: The notice needs reading in full before assuming the saved date is the last instruction date.

customer_goal: The investment statement shows a distribution but no money reached my bank account. I had selected reinvestment.
decision_basis: The unit-allocation record needs checking before treating the missing bank payment as a missing distribution.

customer_goal: I changed my fund distribution instruction to cash, but the latest statement still shows extra units.
decision_basis: The effective date of the change needs comparing with the distribution event date.

customer_goal: My mortgage settlement moved by a week after the lender issued the discharge quote.
decision_basis: The quote needs checking for the revised day rather than assuming the original amount still applies.

customer_goal: The personal loan payout quote names Friday, but I was planning to pay it on Monday.
decision_basis: The validity of the Friday figure for Monday needs confirming with the lender.

customer_goal: The bank profile now shows my new address, but a letter I downloaded still has the old one.
decision_basis: The earlier letter and the current profile may refer to different record dates.

customer_goal: I changed my address after the annual statement was prepared and want to know why that statement did not change.
decision_basis: A prepared statement and a later record update need distinguishing.

customer_goal: The bank acknowledged my account switch, but I have not received confirmation about a recurring credit.
decision_basis: The recurring credit needs its own status check alongside the switch record.

customer_goal: The home insurer arranged an inspection after I reported damage. I assumed that meant the claim was accepted.
decision_basis: The inspection stage should be distinguished from a coverage decision.

customer_goal: The contents insurer requested photographs and I am unsure whether this is an approval or another evidence request.
decision_basis: A request for photographs does not itself state a coverage result.

customer_goal: The bank quote expired while I checked the recipient details, and I am unsure whether the old rate is still reserved.
decision_basis: The quote validity and recipient verification are separate steps.

customer_goal: The bank lets me ask questions about a relative account, but I am unsure whether that includes changing payment details.
decision_basis: Permission to ask questions may have a different scope from authority to change an instruction.

customer_goal: The bank gave instructions only in a phone recording, but I need a written response I can read at my own pace.
decision_basis: A written response request concerns delivery as well as the underlying service enquiry.

customer_goal: Our bookkeeper left and the work email was disabled. I want to check whether the business account approval role is still active.
decision_basis: The bank permission needs checking rather than inferring its status from the disabled email.

customer_goal: A former employee is still listed in business banking although payroll has removed the employee record.
decision_basis: The payroll record and the banking user record are separate systems.

customer_goal: The bank summary covers the year printed at the top, but I downloaded account entries for only six months.
decision_basis: The different ranges can affect the totals and need reconciling before further conclusions.

customer_goal: The ATM printed a receipt but returned my card without cash; the account shows an entry.
decision_basis: The receipt and account entry need matching to that failed dispense.

customer_goal: The ATM gave the cash but the receipt printer failed, and I need to identify the account entry.
decision_basis: The account reference can be checked even without a printed receipt.

customer_goal: The debit card works at a shop but fails in the phone wallet after the phone was replaced.
decision_basis: The device record needs checking separately from the working physical card.

customer_goal: A later invoice message gave different account details, but I stopped before sending the payment.
decision_basis: The changed request can be reported without assuming a completed transfer.

customer_goal: I changed a future transfer early, but the next-payment preview still shows the old amount.
decision_basis: The confirmation and preview need comparing for the relevant scheduled date.

customer_goal: The bank confirms my card dispute attachment arrived, and I want to know whether that is an outcome.
decision_basis: The receipt does not itself state a dispute result.

customer_goal: My deposit account offer ends mid-month, but the statement closes at month-end.
decision_basis: Those dates serve different purposes.

customer_goal: The card rate offer ended before the next statement was issued, and I cannot identify the change date.
decision_basis: The offer end and statement issue dates should be checked separately.

customer_goal: The deposit instruction portal says completed but the email only acknowledges receipt.
decision_basis: The two messages may describe different stages of the same request.

customer_goal: The investment note says the trade occurred yesterday, but the cash entry is scheduled later.
decision_basis: The scheduled cash movement should be checked against settlement rather than the trade date alone.

customer_goal: My bank transfer receipt is dated Monday, but the mortgage payment appears on Tuesday.
decision_basis: The sending and applied dates need distinguishing.

customer_goal: The personal loan lender confirms receipt, but I cannot tell which repayment period it was applied to.
decision_basis: Allocation needs checking independently of receipt.

customer_goal: I asked the mortgage hardship team to call outside my medical appointment, but the callback was booked during it.
decision_basis: The callback arrangement needs checking without assuming an assessment result.

customer_goal: The personal loan hardship team booked a call and I am unsure whether that means my request is accepted.
decision_basis: The appointment is not itself an outcome notice.

customer_goal: During the overdue loan call I suggested an amount, but the later message only says proposal received.
decision_basis: The proposal should not be treated as an agreement without confirmation.

customer_goal: The collections team emailed a confirmed loan arrangement, but my notes contain the smaller amount I originally proposed.
decision_basis: The original notes and the confirmed terms need comparing.

customer_goal: The transaction account disappeared from the app and I cannot tell whether closure completed or access changed.
decision_basis: The missing display does not itself identify the recorded closure status.

customer_goal: I have two schedules for my home cover with different effective dates and need the current version.

customer_goal: Estate account letters come to me, but I need to know whether that means I can instruct a payment.

customer_goal: The business deposit statement closes mid-month, but our internal report ends at month-end.
decision_basis: The closing dates describe different periods.

customer_goal: The business transaction export covers four weeks, while the statement covers the calendar month.

decision_basis: The communication request needs separating from any proposal about amounts.

decision_basis: The receipt does not itself establish the recorded instruction authority.

decision_basis: The support role should not be assumed to create account authority.

customer_goal: I requested an interpreter for the bank meeting but the confirmation only names the meeting time.
decision_basis: The meeting time and support booking need separate confirmation.

customer_goal: The credited savings interest appears in transactions, but the accrual display restarted from a smaller figure.
decision_basis: The new accrual display needs comparing with the crediting period.

customer_goal: I increased the debit purchase control but an ATM withdrawal is still declined.

customer_goal: My card cash control was lowered, but I cannot tell whether that also affects shop payments.
